* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet (official text as of 15 March 2010), which prints the first sentence as the pilot icon with “2.”; the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, still on 12 December 2012) prints the same text with the pilot icon written out: “Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. Opponent may not add destiny draws to power or attrition here. Ice Storm and Sandwhirl are canceled at same and related locations.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 15 March 2010"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022213441/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="cl-1263_6-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive)</ref> The Virtual Block 6.3 sheet came out on 12 March 2010, three days before the date it carries<ref name="pc-6_3-release">Players Committee home page, news “Virtual Block 6.3: Mercenaries – Released!”, posted 4:40pm Friday, 12 March 2010, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20100409002355/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ 9 April 2010] (Internet Archive); the Players Committee Twitter account wrote on 13 March 2010 that the set “has been released early!” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20100721144451/http://twitter.com/swccg Internet Archive copy])</ref>.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Mercenary Shadow Pirate (Errata)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 12) changed “Ice Storm and Sandwhirl” to “Sandwhirl and Ice Storm” (pilot icon with “2.” as on the original): “Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. Opponent may not add destiny draws to power or attrition here. Sandwhirl and Ice Storm are canceled at same and related locations.”.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014).
